responsibility: Defines rustc_middle’s hook extension boundary by declaring a provider table of downstream-supplied function pointers, exposing `TyCtxt`/`TyCtxtAt` entrypoints that invoke those operations as part of the tcx-facing API, and supplying default panic-on-use providers when no hook has been installed. The module’s role is to let selected compiler operations be provided externally without adding query machinery or direct crate dependencies.
